description: Token savings benchmarks — measures Claude context tokens with vs without shunt

benchmarks.name: single-large-file
benchmarks.description: Read a 602-line service and summarize exports
benchmarks.question: What are all the exported items and what do they do?

benchmarks.name: multi-file-cross-read
benchmarks.description: Read three files and answer a cross-cutting question
benchmarks.question: Which classes and interfaces are exported across these files, and how do they relate to each other?

benchmarks.name: source-plus-test
benchmarks.description: Read source and test pair to understand coverage
benchmarks.question: What methods does UserService have, and which ones would be covered if we wrote tests following the OrderService test pattern?

benchmarks.name: code-generation
benchmarks.spec: Write unit tests for UserService following the exact same patterns, structure, and assertions as the OrderService tests.
